title: agropyron schrenkianum
intro: Agropyron schrenkianum, commonly known as Schrenk's wheat-grass or Schrenk's wildrye, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Agropyron schrenkianum include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
